import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a DataFrame from the given data
data = {
    "amount": [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    "is_fraud": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    "transaction_type": ["refund", "payment", "transfer", "payment", "payment"],
    "hour_of_day": [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert hour_of_day to categorical type
df['hour_of_day'] = pd.Categorical(df['hour_of_day'])

# Plot a bar chart of transaction count by hour
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', data=df)
plt.title('Transaction Count by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
